pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with jagged pixel gradients and sharp edge angularity, predominantly visible on the lower-right and lower-left quadrants; upper regions show significant morphology loss due to textural occlusion.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thin, off-white interstitial pathways forming clear junction nodes on the lower flank; the topological graph is fragmented and loses continuity in the dorsal and cervical regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency bristly silhouette along the upper cervical ridge against the sky background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Distinct structural discontinuities in the dorsal line caused by protruding, irregular masses that disrupt the expected smooth curvature of the shoulder and neck.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive, raised, dark-grey to black cauliflower-like nodules with high textural disruption concentrated on the upper cervical, shoulder, and dorsal-lateral regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe, widespread crusty skin lesions covering approximately 50% of the visible torso, resulting in profound topographical distortion of the skin surface.
